premise: On his first day Leo freezes at the foot of the lander's ladder; Maya counts his first steps out onto the plain with him, one at a time.
inspiration: 'Jack and the Beanstalk' (English folk tale), turned: climbing down, not up, into a new world that turns out to be gentle.
lesson: A friend counting with you makes a big step smaller.

en-US.title: One Small Step
en-US.text: Down onto the landing pad came the {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} lander, its feet settling softly in the dust. {lander:live hold} {sfx:hiss} Its hatch swung open and its ladder slid down to the ground. And down the ladder, very carefully, came {man:enter} {man:go to lander} Leo. It was his very first day on the Moon. {man:face sad} [nervously] At the bottom rung he stopped. Beyond the pad the grey plain stretched away, silent and strange. {man:shake 0.4} {woman:enter} Maya came loping up {woman:face happy} and waved. {woman:says} [warmly] “It's all right. One step at a time. I'll count.” {man:says} [nervously] “One…” {man:pulse} Leo stepped off, and his boot sank softly into the dust. {woman:says} “Two… three…” {man:go to woman} Each step floated a little, like a slow bounce. {man:face surprised} [gasps] He didn't sink. He didn't fall. {man:face happy} He was walking on the Moon! {man:says} [laughs] “Four, five, six, SEVEN!” {man:hop x3} {woman:hearts} [happily] And from then on, nobody counted.

es-ES.title: Un pequeño paso
es-ES.text: Sobre la plataforma de aterrizaje bajó el {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} módulo lunar, y sus patas se posaron suavemente en el polvo. {lander:live hold} {sfx:hiss} Se abrió su escotilla y bajó la escalerilla hasta el suelo. Y por la escalerilla, con mucho cuidado, bajó {man:enter} {man:go to lander} Leo. Era su primer día en la Luna. {man:face sad} [nervously] En el último peldaño se paró. Más allá de la plataforma, la llanura gris se extendía, silenciosa y extraña. {man:shake 0.4} {woman:enter} Maya llegó dando saltos {woman:face happy} y le saludó. {woman:says} [warmly] «Tranquilo. Paso a paso. Yo cuento.» {man:says} [nervously] «Uno…» {man:pulse} Leo bajó, y su bota se hundió suavemente en el polvo. {woman:says} «Dos… tres…» {man:go to woman} Cada paso flotaba un poco, como un bote lento. {man:face surprised} [gasps] No se hundía. No se caía. {man:face happy} ¡Estaba caminando por la Luna! {man:says} [laughs] «¡Cuatro, cinco, seis, SIETE!» {man:hop x3} {woman:hearts} [happily] Y desde entonces, nadie volvió a contar.
